title: VIX Reaches 30 as U.S. Stock Futures Decline in Premarket Trading
text:
VIX Reaches 30 as U.S. Stock Futures Decline in Premarket Trading | TokenPost 
 Advertisement Friday, November 20, 2026 Sections Sign in News Markets Feed Data Research Home Investing 1 min read Add as a preferred source on Google VIX Reaches 30 as U.S. Stock Futures Decline in Premarket Trading
 The volatility index hit its highest intraday level since late March. Bitcoin fell to $61,225, its lowest price in more than four months.
 By Enna Lee Published Nov 20, 2026, 8:25 AM EST Save Share Mentioned assets BTC Bitcoin 
 Dark exchange glass reflects a steeply descending market chart / TokenPost.ai The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) reached 30 in U.S. premarket trading Nov. 20, its highest intraday level since late March, as U.S. stock futures declined.
 Nasdaq 100 futures fell 1.86%, S&P 500 futures dropped 0.95% and Dow futures lost 0.29% in the premarket session.
 West Texas Intermediate crude futures slipped 0.23% to $82.247 a barrel, while Brent crude futures fell 0.70% to $91.334. Spot gold and silver each declined 1.31%, to $3,577.41 and $42.29 an ounce, respectively.
 European indexes also fell: Germany’s DAX declined 2.23%, Italy’s FTSE MIB lost 2.15%, France’s CAC 40 fell 1.64% and Britain’s FTSE 100 slipped 0.92%.
 Bitcoin (BTC) dropped to $61,225 intraday, its lowest level in more than four months.
